correctness.rationale: For every strictly positive infection and interior susceptible-strategy initial state with w<1, the cube and positivity are invariant. Direct differentiation of the nonnegative entropy gives -beta_p A(z)(y-q)^2 plus a bounded perturbation Delta*w; the logistic w integral is exactly known. Uniform entropy bounds yield a compact interior trajectory, its finite prevalence-energy and derivative boundedness force y to q and then z to p. Exact symbolic factorization and rational sample checks reproduce critical computations; simulations are not treated as proof.

value.rationale: Convergence for arbitrary finite reaction speeds closes a mathematically meaningful gap between existing local stability and time-scale-separated analyses, ruling out other recurrent attractors in the specified open parameter region. The explicit initial-state-dependent dissipation budget quantifies transient epidemic deviation and its dependence on the infected-strategy adaptation rate. This is a structural theorem rather than a routine small numerical example.
